data.name: Sharwateek
data.long_meaning: One who is blessed with the grace of the gods, Sharwateek is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sharva' meaning God and 'teek' meaning victory or protection.

It symbolizes a deep faith in the grace and protection of the gods, offering a sense of safety and comfort. It is a constant reminder that despite the challenges in life, one is never alone, and the divine is always present, guiding and supporting.
